sentences.text: The UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 state that the penal-charges instructions apply to fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards, and they do not state a move date for existing loan accounts.

The earlier penal-charges instruction for existing loans said the switchover to the new penal-charges regime should be on the next review or renewal date or six months from the effective date of those instructions, whichever was earlier, but that instruction is superseded.

missing.slot: specific move date for existing loan accounts under the 2025 directions
